details.intro:
The Death of Joseph (Mors Joseph, CAVT 117) recounts the final illness, testament, death and burial of the patriarch Joseph in Egypt. In Ethiopic EMML 1939 it follows the History of Joseph (CAVT 113). That pairing already existed in the Arabic Vorlage.

CAVT lists only the Ethiopic, but an Arabic version survives in Cairo, Coptic Patriarchate 272 (Graf: “der Tod Josephs, des Sohnes des Jakob Israel”). The Arabic Dormitio Joseph (CAVT 116) is very likely the same text, and the two entries should be combined (Butts, Heal, Moseley and Witztum 2017).
details.provenance:
Language: Geʿez, translated from Arabic.
Edition status: no published edition of the Geʿez or the Arabic. Aaron M. Butts reported an edition and translation of both versions in progress (2017).
Witnesses: EMML 1939 (Ḥayq Esṭifānos, per CAVT; late 14th–early 15th c.), fols. 162r–168r; Cairo, Coptic Patriarchate 272 (Arabic).
details.manuscripts:
• Ethiopic: EMML 1939 (vHMML manifest 203769), fols. 162r–168r (14th–15th c.).
  • Arabic: Cairo, Coptic Patriarchate 272 (Graf, GCAL 1.205).
  • Arabic (probably the same text, CAVT 116): Cairo, Qaṣrīyat al-Rīḥān 115, Hagr. 12 (probably destroyed).
